title: MyCoords
description: Lightweight Minecraft Paper plugin that provides a simple and configurable way for players to view their current coordinates directly in chat.
body:
**MyCoords** is a lightweight Minecraft Paper plugin that provides a simple and configurable way for players to view their current coordinates directly in chat. ### Key Features * View coordinates using a single command * Toggle the command on or off * Change coordinate text color * Show or hide the X/Y/Z prefix * Adjustable decimal precision * Lightweight and server-friendly * Server-side only (no client mods required) ### Functionality In vanilla Minecraft, players typically rely on the debug screen to check their coordinates, which can be distracting during gameplay. MyCoords allows players to quickly display their current X, Y, and Z coordinates in chat using `/c`. Players can customize how the coordinates are displayed, including color, precision, and formatting, all without requiring a server restart. ### Commands | Command | Description | | ---------------------- | -------------------------------------- | | `/c` | Displays your current coordinates | | `/c toggle` | Enables or disables coordinate display | | `/c color ` | Changes the coordinate text color | | `/c prefix` | Shows or hides the X/Y/Z prefix | | `/c decimals ` | Sets how many decimal places are shown | ### Installation MyCoords is a server-side plugin and does not need to be installed on the client. --- ### Credits Special thanks to my girlfriend for making the project icon!
